owner: Power Stack investment research; Alchemy Live Desk retains canonical market regime and Motion authority

sourcePrecedence: Issuer-published earnings, presentation and SEC or Taiwan exchange filing
Existing Alchemy Live canonical snapshot (rates, credit, breadth, regime, promoted Motion; only when timestamp/source health valid)
Credible contemporaneous reporting and financial-data vendors with source/as-of metadata
policy.ratingRule: Never modify company score, ranking, conviction or holding quantities from the event calendar, issuer-free estimates, Live Motion, creator interviews or a broad price reaction. Verify issuer evidence, current security price and valuation separately.
policy.degradedRule: If current issuer/market evidence is unavailable or the Live input is stale/degraded, record UNKNOWN / RESEARCH_GAP; do not generate a compensating PS macro regime or assume a positive or negative release.
policy.noNewFeed: Consume the existing Live Desk snapshot; do not copy API keys or create a separate PS macro or provider polling schedule.

events.timeBasis: Issuer IR conference time: Thursday 15 October 2026 14:00 Taiwan time (MYT is same UTC+8). Results documents may appear ahead of the conference.

marketBaseline.semiconductors: Weakness in chip/memory shares; do not equate price declines with cancellations of AI orders.
marketBaseline.liveSnapshot: Power Stack committed Live snapshot dossier as-of 2026-10-12T22:11:23.968+00:00; status degraded_latest; not fresh company evidence or October 15 earnings.
marketBaseline.credit: Current canonical HY/IG credit transmission unresolved in the prior PS snapshot. Do not fill missing confirmation with unaudited market narrative.

knownPreRelease.q3Revenue: TSMC already reported approximately NT$1.49 trillion Q3 2026 revenue, up around 50% year-on-year (published 8 October); strong revenue is not proof of AI lab profitability.
knownPreRelease.q3RevenueGuidance: Issuer's prior Q3 2026 revenue guide: US$44.6B–45.8B.
knownPreRelease.grossMarginGuide: Issuer's prior Q3 2026 gross margin guide: 65.0%–67.0%.
knownPreRelease.operatingMarginGuide: Issuer's prior Q3 2026 operating margin guide: 56.0%–58.0%.
knownPreRelease.streetProfitEstimate: Reuters 12 October: analysts expect about NT$746.3B Q3 net profit, ~65% year-on-year; a street estimate, not an issued result.
knownPreRelease.notes: Currency translation can make TWD reported revenue differ from USD guidance; compare periods, units and FX first.

checks.why: Whether 3nm/HPC/advanced packaging demand converts revenue into durable profitability
checks.evidence: Reported Q3 gross and operating margins versus issuer guidance, management explanation
checks.positive: Margin stability/beat with healthy product mix and disclosed cost drivers
checks.negative: Unexplained deterioration or a weak forward margin guide

checks.topic: Forward AI order quality and capacity
checks.why: Discriminates full datacentre funding and HBM bottlenecks from headline backlog
checks.evidence: Issuer Q4 revenue/margin outlook, 2026 and 2027 capex commentary, HPC contribution, CoWoS expansion utilisation, customer order commentary
checks.positive: Broad, executable AI orders and guidance that supports sustained actual utilisation
checks.negative: Confirmed deferral/cancellation of orders or utilisation decline, particularly across multiple customers

checks.topic: Free cash flow and capital intensity
checks.why: High capex is tolerable if realised economics can fund it
checks.evidence: Cash from operations, cash capex, FCF, 2026 capex outlook and return/utilisation context
checks.positive: Healthy cash generation relative to investment and delivery costs
checks.negative: Deteriorating operating cash conversion or rising investment with weaker realised orders

checks.topic: AI financing and external paying customers
checks.why: Tests Eisman's circular-funding concern beyond a hardware provider
checks.evidence: Independent OpenAI/Anthropic/Oracle/cloud customer payment and financing disclosures from their own filings; NOT deduced from TSMC earnings
checks.positive: Funded third-party demand and counterparties collecting cash
checks.negative: Financing failure accompanied by actual supplier order cuts and weaker forecasts

checks.why: Separates fundamental earnings from macro repricing and concentration
checks.evidence: Post-release TSM/SMH/QQQ relative price action, 2Y/10Y/30Y real/nominal yields and credit/breadth via dated Live canonical feeds
checks.positive: Sustained order strength plus breadth stabilisation without credit stress
checks.negative: Order/earnings cuts alongside spreads widening and weak breadth ex-AI

interpretation.condition: Strong actual margins, order/utilisation guidance and cash conversion; financed projects remain supported
interpretation.portfolioTranslation: Maintain existing scored suppliers and study entries for GEV/ETN/MU/CRDO; no automatic buy/score lift from TSMC alone.

interpretation.condition: Capex expansion moderates, but profitability/FCF and real customer demand improve; no verified order failure
interpretation.portfolioTranslation: Do not treat lower gross capex as a bubble pop. Compare expected returns on capital and valuation.

interpretation.condition: Material funding/collection problems plus confirmed order slowdown, worsening cash economics and/or sustained credit stress
interpretation.portfolioTranslation: Review AI/power factor concentration, YTLPOWR and linked warrant, and supplier share entry gates before committing capital; still no mechanical score change.

interpretation.condition: Results, issuer confirmation or canonical credit/breadth evidence missing
interpretation.portfolioTranslation: Preserve prior thesis, label RESEARCH_GAP and request first-party document readback.

events.researchBudget: Use an existing PowerSweep watchlist or theme deep-dive slot. Do not create a parallel unlimited earnings research queue.
